findings.title: Extended pay-when-paid terms
findings.deviation: The contract stipulates a 60-day payment period after the quarter end and only after Datavane receives payment from the customer, whereas the playbook requires a maximum of 45 days and forbids pay-when-paid terms.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces significant cash-flow risk and may never be paid for services performed if the end customer defaults or delays payment.
findings.quote: Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.
findings.counterPosition: Payment within 30 days of receipt of invoice (45 days maximum); no pay-when-paid.

findings.title: Asymmetric and uncapped liability
findings.deviation: The contract caps Datavane's liability at $10,000 while leaving AtliQ's liability uncapped for several broad categories including indemnity and non-solicitation.
findings.impact: AtliQ is exposed to unlimited financial risk while having virtually no recourse against Datavane for significant losses.
findings.quote: DATAVANE'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING UNDER SECTION 11.2, SHALL NOT EXCEED TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000). ... NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT PARTNER'S LIABILITY UNDER SECTION 5, SECTION 9 OR SECTION 11.1.
findings.counterPosition: Mutual cap of 1x fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; carve-outs limited to fraud, wilful misconduct and breach of confidentiality.

findings.title: One-way uncapped indemnity
findings.deviation: AtliQ is required to provide a broad, uncapped indemnity for various performance-related issues, whereas the playbook requires indemnities to be mutual and subject to the liability cap.
findings.impact: AtliQ could be forced to pay unlimited damages for third-party claims regardless of the actual severity of its fault.
findings.quote: Partner shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Datavane... from and against any and all Losses arising out of or relating to (a) the Partner Services; (b) any breach of this Agreement... Partner's obligations under this Section 11.1 shall not be subject to any limitation or cap.
findings.counterPosition: Each party indemnifies the other for third-party claims caused by its own breach or negligence; indemnities subject to the liability cap (IP infringement excepted).

findings.title: Broad 24-month non-compete
findings.deviation: The contract imposes a 24-month post-term restriction on providing services to any Datavane Account for competing platforms, including existing AtliQ clients.
findings.impact: This prevents AtliQ from working with its own clients on other platforms, effectively allowing Datavane to capture AtliQ's client relationships.
findings.quote: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not... provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.
findings.counterPosition: Delete the restrictive covenant or limit it to a narrow non-solicitation of specific Datavane staff for a maximum of 6 months.

findings.title: One-sided convenience termination
findings.deviation: Datavane can terminate on 15 days' notice, while AtliQ is prohibited from terminating for convenience during the initial 3-year term.
findings.impact: AtliQ is locked into a long-term commitment while Datavane can exit at any time with minimal notice.
findings.quote: Datavane may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, upon fifteen (15) days' written notice to Partner. ... Partner acknowledges... that Partner may not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial term.
findings.counterPosition: Mutual notice period of at least 30 days for termination for convenience.

findings.title: Forfeiture of fees on termination
findings.deviation: The clause denies payment for any revenue share or referrals not 'fully paid' by the customer before the termination date.
findings.impact: AtliQ may lose payment for services already completed if the customer pays after the termination date.
findings.quote: no revenue share or referral fee shall be payable in respect of any Joint Deal or referral not fully paid by the relevant Datavane Account before the effective date of termination
findings.counterPosition: Payment for all services performed up to termination, including work in progress and all earned referral fees.

findings.title: Perpetual license to AtliQ tools
findings.deviation: AtliQ must grant a perpetual, irrevocable license for any templates or accelerators it submits to the marketplace.
findings.impact: AtliQ loses control over its proprietary pre-existing tools and accelerators by granting Datavane perpetual rights to them.
findings.quote: Partner hereby grants Datavane a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use any feedback, connectors, templates or implementation accelerators that Partner submits to the Datavane Partner Marketplace.
findings.counterPosition: AtliQ retains background IP and grants a non-exclusive, perpetual, royalty-free licence to use it only as part of the deliverables provided to specific customers.

fine.note: No liquidated damages or delay penalties are included in this partnership agreement.
The professional services warranty is standard and acceptable.
Confidentiality terms are mutual and largely align with the standard.
